A team of students made *Tile Garden*, a calm puzzle game for phones.
Players play **5 minutes** at a time. The team has money for one more
platform: PC, console or cloud gaming.

## Task 1 · Platforms

a) Which is a limit of a **console** for *Tile Garden*? Write **A**, **B**
or **C**. (A) a dev kit and certification cost money and time (B) every
player has the same hardware (C) a big TV screen

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) A player wants to play *Tile Garden* through cloud gaming with a ping of
**90 ms** (the stream adds about 40 ms). What is the total delay (ms)? Is it
a problem for this calm game (yes / no)?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · Three criteria

| criterion | PC | console | cloud |
|---|---|---|---|
| reach | 4 | 2 | 3 |
| fit for the game | 4 | 3 | 5 |
| cost and time | 5 | 1 | 3 |

a) Add up the total of each platform. Which one comes first?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Why does the cloud get 5 in "fit for the game"? Write **A** or **B**.
(A) a calm puzzle game does not mind the delay of the stream (B) the cloud
is the cheapest platform

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) The team wants players to continue their garden on the new platform
with the same account. Which feature is this: cross-save or cross-play?
